title_zh: 詹姆斯与大仙桃（勉强算在一起）

lines.en: : Okay, everyone! Due to a sudden shortage in paper, we’ll be playing tonight’s game of bar trivia the old-fashioned way! By yelling out the answers for points!
lines.zh: : 好了各位!由于纸张突然短缺,今晚的酒吧问答我们用老派方式来进行!喊出答案来积分!

lines.en: : The game will begin in five minutes, so finalize your strategies now! And remember- teams of two only!
lines.zh: : 比赛五分钟后开始,现在就敲定你们的策略!记住——只能两人一队!

lines.en: : How did things come to this?
lines.zh: : 事情是怎么走到这一步的?

lines.en: : Seeing as your fake-amnesia is acting up again, I will now recap the last hour of your life. Buckle up, Arakawa. This is going to be good.
lines.zh: : 鉴于你的「假性失忆」又发作了,我现在为你复盘你人生的最后一个小时。系好安全带,荒川。会很精彩。

lines.en: : I have a very strong feeling it won’t be.
lines.zh: : 我有种强烈的预感:不会精彩。

lines.en: : The day started normally- when you woke up and decided to go at least another twenty-four hours as the unlovable degenerate you are.
lines.zh: : 一切从平常开始——你醒来,决定继续以你这副讨人嫌的堕落姿态,再活至少二十四小时。

lines.en: : Things proceeded as normal until Imani, also a degenerate, decided tonight would be a good night for the four of us girls to hang out here for a game of bar trivia.
lines.zh: : 事情一如既往,直到 Imani——同样是个堕落分子——认定今晚适合我们四个女孩来这里玩酒吧问答。

lines.en: : You, someone who was not invited, showed up shortly after. And while this would be a tragedy under most circumstances, it wound up working out due to her sudden bout of food poisoning.
lines.zh: : 而你这个没被邀请的人,不久后出现了。虽然大多数情况下这都是悲剧,但因为她的突发食物中毒,居然就凑成了。

lines.en: : Now, we are enemies and my lover and I will defeat you. Only to subsequently force some form of punishment on the two of you that you will rue for the rest of your lives.
lines.zh: : 现在,我们是敌人,我和我的爱人会击败你们。随后再对你们俩施加某种你们会后悔终生的惩罚。

lines.en: : I hope you are ready to be completely and utterly decimated.
lines.zh: : 希望你已经准备好被碾成齑粉。

lines.en: : Thanks, Wakana. You should just handle all of my inner monologues from now on. That was more fun than any recap I could have given.
lines.zh: : 谢了,Wakana。以后我的内心独白都交给你处理吧。这比我自己的版本有趣多了。

lines.en: : It is painful enough being stuck in my own mind. The last thing I want is to be stuck inside of yours as well.
lines.zh: : 被困在自己的脑子里已经够痛苦了。我可不想再被困在你的脑子里。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re up for this, Rika?
lines.zh: : 你确定你应付得来吗,Rika?

lines.en: : Up for it? I was born for this.
lines.zh: : 应付得来?我为这一天而生。

lines.en: : I might not seem like it, but I’m a god damn expert at useless trivia. Those dykes next to us don’t stand a chance.
lines.zh: : 我看上去可能不像,但我是他妈的冷知识专家。旁边那两个蕾丝边,一点机会都没有。

lines.en: : Woah. I’m all about the competitive spirit and shit, but isn’t it kind of messed up to throw slurs at your own people?
lines.zh: : 哇。我虽然拥护竞争精神什么的,但对自己人喊蔑称,是不是有点过分了?

lines.en: : Love no one. Everyone is your enemy, dick or no dick. Hail Satan.
lines.zh: : 谁都不爱。人人皆敌,有屌没屌都一样。荣耀归于撒旦。

lines.en: : Arakawa, tame your partner before my beloved kicks her head off.
lines.zh: : Arakawa,管好你的搭档,不然我的爱人要把她的头踢飞了。

lines.en: : Rika, calm down.
lines.zh: : Rika,冷静。

lines.en: : Fuck you, goober. Do you have any idea what I had to do the last time I lost a punishment game?
lines.zh: : 滚你的,傻鹅。你知道我上次输了惩罚游戏之后经历了什么吗?

lines.en: : No, but I feel like I’m obligated to ask now.
lines.zh: : 不知道,但现在我觉得我有义务问一下。

lines.en: : Let’s just say it involves a remote-controlled device and me being hunched over an apple display at the grocery store, trying to keep my mouth closed.
lines.zh: : 这么说吧,涉及一个遥控装置、以及我弯腰趴在超市的水果陈列架上,拼命闭紧嘴巴。

lines.en: : Or maybe it was potatoes. I don’t remember. I was too busy regretting everything I’d ever done.
lines.zh: : 也可能是土豆。我不记得了。我当时忙着后悔自己这辈子干过的每一件事。

lines.en: : That just sounds like a Wednesday for Osako.
lines.zh: : 这听着就像 Osako 的普通周三。

lines.en: : Shh!
: Zap.
: Mm! Ahem...ahem...
: Shh. Did anyone else just hear that?
lines.zh: : 嘘。你们刚才有没有听到什么?

lines.en: : Ignore the exhibitionists for a moment. We need to listen to the announcer and figure out our strategy for the game.
lines.zh: : 先别管 Exhibitionist。我们得听主持人讲规则,想想比赛策略。

lines.en: : Okay! It’s time to start!
lines.zh: : 好!开始!

lines.en: : Nevermind. Just try not to get anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 算了。尽力别答错就行。

lines.en: : Same goes for you. Don’t hold me back, Sensei. Me and Imani are undefeated so far.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。别拖我后腿,Sensei。我和 Imani 到目前为止保持全胜。

lines.en: : Granted, we’ve only played one game, but still! I’m not going to lose to a loving, affectionate, and hypersexual couple while being fresh off a long-term relationship! It would be too painful!
lines.zh: : 固然,我们只玩过一局,但那也是全胜!我才不要输给一对恩爱黏糊、欲火焚身的情侣——我可刚结束一段长期关系!那也太痛了!

lines.en: : Question one...
lines.zh: : 第一题……

lines.en: : In “Game of Thrones,” what is the translation of the High Valyrian term “valar dohaeris?”
lines.zh: : 在《权力的游戏》里,高瓦雷利亚语「valar dohaeris」翻译过来是什么?

lines.en: : Do you know this? You read those books, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?你读过那套书吧?

lines.en: : No. But we did keep the television series on while we were having sex several Sundays out of every year. You just likely don’t remember it since you were always tied up and robbed of your senses.
lines.zh: : 没有。但每年好几个周日我们做爱时,都开着那部剧。你多半不记得了,因为你总是被绑着、被剥夺感官。

lines.en: : All men must serve!
lines.zh: : 凡人皆需侍奉!

lines.en: : I have also had sex with that show on in the background!
lines.zh: : 我也开着那部剧做过!

lines.en: : That...information was not necessary. But you are correct!
lines.zh: : 这个……信息没有必要。但你答对了!

lines.en: : LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOOO!
lines.zh: : 他妈的冲啊啊啊啊!

lines.en: : Oh, calm down. You got one question right.
lines.zh: : 哦,冷静点。你不过答对一题。

lines.en: : You know, this is a side of you I don’t particularly dislike. Especially since it means we’ll be able to punish our lesbian friends.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,你的这一面我并不讨厌。尤其这意味着我们能惩罚我们的蕾丝边朋友了。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah! I got so caught up in how great at trivia I am that I completely forgot we can mess with them. Is there anything we-
lines.zh: : 哦,对!我光顾着得意自己多有问答天赋,完全忘了我们可以捉弄她们。有没有什么我们——

lines.en: : Question two!
lines.zh: : 第二题!

lines.en: : Fuck it! We’ll figure that out later! Just shut up and let me think!
lines.zh: : 去他的!那个待会再说!闭嘴,让我想!

lines.en: : I haven’t even said anything. Also, please don’t attack me unless our clothes are off. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没说。另外,请别袭击我——除非我们衣服都脱了。谢谢。

lines.en: : Jesus. Rika’s even more aggressive today than she was last time.
lines.zh: : 天。Rika 今天比上次还凶。

lines.en: : Shut it, carpet muncher!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,舔的那位!

lines.en: : Wasn’t it just the other day you were commenting on how good you are at-
lines.zh: : 前几天不还是你在评价自己有多擅长——

lines.en: : Shh! Question two!
lines.zh: : 嘘!第二题!

lines.en: : “Spiker” and “Sponge” are the antagonists of which Roald Dahl children’s book?
lines.zh: : 「Spiker」和「Sponge」是罗尔德·达尔哪一本童书里的反派?

lines.en: : Oh, I actually know this one.
lines.zh: : 哦,这题我 actually 会。

lines.en: : What? Then say it. We’re supposed to yell stuff out. Don’t just let Rika and Sensei win.
lines.zh: : 什么?那快答啊。规则就是喊出来。别让 Rika 和 Sensei 赢了。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不?

lines.en: : Uhh...because you said you were going to decimate him? And because winning is awesome?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为你说要把他碾成渣?还因为赢很爽?

lines.en: : That is true. But with each passing question, I’m becoming more aware that our punishment will likely be sexual in nature and now I’m just curious about what they’d have us do.
lines.zh: : 是真的。但每过一题,我就越来越清楚地意识到:我们的惩罚多半会和性有关,而现在我只是好奇他们会让我们做什么。

lines.en: : There have...been two questions.
lines.zh: : 目前……一共才两题。

lines.en: : I’m afraid I don’t see your point, my love.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不明白你的重点,我的爱。

lines.en: : Wakana, we can have sex literally any time we want.
lines.zh: : Wakana,我们随时想做就能做,字面意义上的随时。

lines.en: : Yes, but how many opportunities do we have to be punished by other people?
lines.zh: : 对,但被「别人」惩罚的机会有多少?

lines.en: : I volunteer to do that exact thing literally any time you want.
lines.zh: : 这种事,你想要的任何时刻,我都可以自愿效劳。

lines.en: : Shut it!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴!

lines.en: : The two of us are going to beat you guys fair and square and you’ll both regret ever making us-
lines.zh: : 我们俩会堂堂正正地击败你们,然后你们会后悔让我们——

lines.en: : Zap.
: Eep!
: Zap.
: Zap.
: Zap.
: Mm...mm!
: It’s never too late to concede, my dear. There will be other trivia games.
lines.zh: : 认输永远不晚,亲爱的。以后还有问答比赛。

lines.en: : Wakana! We’re with our friends! Stop!
lines.zh: : Wakana!我们在朋友面前!住手!

lines.en: : Question three: How many times can I make you cum before you swallow your pride and follow me into the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 第三题:我要让你去几次,你才会咽下骄傲、跟我进洗手间?

lines.en: : Hey! No quitting! Just cross your legs really tightly and tough it out like a real woman!
lines.zh: : 喂!不许弃权!把双腿夹紧、像真正的女人一样硬扛过去!

lines.en: : Wakana!
lines.zh: : Wakana!

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God! Fine!
lines.zh: : 我的天!行!

lines.en: : One punishment please, opposing team.
lines.zh: : 对方队伍,请给我们发一个惩罚。

lines.en: : Fine. Help me paint a wardrobe I found on the side of the road. Rin won’t let me use hers anymore.
lines.zh: : 行。帮我粉刷我从路边捡的一个衣柜。Rin 不再让我用她的了。

lines.en: : Arakawa, I can’t believe I am saying this, but please think up a punishment for my lover and me.
lines.zh: : Arakawa,我不敢相信我要说这句话,但请为我和我的爱人想一个惩罚。

lines.en: : Paint Rika’s wardrobe, but do it naked.
lines.zh: : 粉刷 Rika 的衣柜,脱光粉。

lines.en: : Ooooh, good one.
lines.zh: : 哦哦,好主意。

lines.en: : You two are worthless.
lines.zh: : 你们两个废物。

lines.en: : Come now, Osako. I’ll think up my own way to punish you.
lines.zh: : 来吧,Osako。我会自己想出惩罚你的方式的。

lines.en: : Wakanaaaa! Turn the...thing off!
lines.zh: : Wakanaaaa!把那个……东西关掉!

lines.en: : Does...this mean we win?
lines.zh: : 这……是不是说明我们赢了?

lines.en: : I’d...at least like someone to answer the second question so I don’t have to just stand around anymore.
lines.zh: : 我……至少希望有人把第二题答了,这样我就不用继续干站着了。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. James and the Giant Peach.
lines.zh: : 哦,抱歉。《詹姆斯与大仙桃》。

lines.en: : That is correct!
lines.zh: : 正确!

lines.en: : But...seeing as you two are now the only team left, I suppose we’ll take a quick intermission and wait for your friends to return from...yeah.
lines.zh: : 不过……既然你们俩已经是仅剩的一队,我想我们中场休息一下,等你们的朋友从……对,从那边回来。

lines.en: : You can keep asking trivia questions if you want. This is a hidden power of mine and I feel like I’ve barely even gotten to show it off on account of us only making it two rounds in before sex happened.
lines.zh: : 你们想继续问问答的话也行。这是我的一项隐藏天赋,而我感觉我几乎还没来得及展示——毕竟才进行两轮,性就发生了。

lines.en: : No...I think I need a smoke break. But you two have fun for now.
lines.zh: : 不……我需要抽根烟。不过你们俩先玩。

lines.en: : Oh man...I was looking forward to this.
lines.zh: : 哦,天……我本来还挺期待的。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I’m impressed by that last answer. Especially since it was based on a piece of 1960’s literature and not a popular 2000’s television series.
lines.zh: : 如果能安慰你的话,你最后那个答案让我刮目相看。尤其它源于六十年代的文学作品,而不是一部 2000 年代的热门电视剧。

lines.en: : It was one of the first books Rin ever read. Took it right from my collection.
lines.zh: : 那是 Rin 读过的第一批书之一。直接从我藏书中拿走的。

lines.en: : Didn’t take you as much of a reader.
lines.zh: : 我没看出来你还读那么多书。

lines.en: : Used to be. Not so much anymore.
lines.zh: : 以前是。现在不怎么读了。

lines.en: : Just fell out of love with it one day. But it’s not like I was ever reading any of that advanced stuff anyway. It was mainly just children’s books and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就是某一天突然不爱了。反正我也从来没读过什么高深的东西。主要就是童书之类的。

lines.en: : Then where exactly does all of this trivia knowledge that I am definitely sure you possess come from?
lines.zh: : 那这些「我确定你拥有」的冷知识,到底从哪来的?

lines.en: : Hey, what’s with the sarcasm? I’ve got a 100%% correct answer rate so far. You have no reason to doubt me.
lines.zh: : 嘿,阴阳怪气什么?我目前的正确率是百分之百。你没理由怀疑我。

lines.en: : Sure, apart from the sample size being two. It’s just a little weird that you know so much when you claimed yourself to not be very “book smart.” Yet here you are answering questions from two books.
lines.zh: : 是,除了样本量是两。只是有点怪——你自称不是「读书的料」,知识却这么渊博。而眼下你答对的两题,全都来自书。

lines.en: : Game of Thrones was a book?
lines.zh: : 《权力的游戏》是本书?

lines.en: : Rika-
lines.zh: : Rika——

lines.en: : I don’t have a fun or exciting answer for you, man. I’m just good at remembering useless information and I used to watch Jeopardy with Rie back in the day.
lines.zh: : 我没有什么有趣或精彩的答案给你,伙计。我只是擅长记没用的信息,而且当年常和 Rie 一起看 Jeopardy。

lines.en: : Rie being...Rin’s other mom, I’m assuming?
lines.zh: : Rie 是……Rin 的另一位妈妈,我猜?

lines.en: : Yeah. Sorry. Wasn’t aware you didn’t know her name.
lines.zh: : 对。抱歉。我不知道你不知道她的名字。

lines.en: : We were always super competitive about it. But she was way smarter than I was, so she had an upper hand and-
lines.zh: : 我们俩当年较劲较得特别凶。但她比我聪明得多,所以她占上风,而且——

lines.en: : Actually, let’s talk about something else. I don’t want to waste this whole intermission thing reminiscing about stuff that is probably going to make me cry into my beer.
lines.zh: : 其实,我们聊点别的吧。我不想把整个中场休息,浪费在回忆那些大概率会让我把眼泪掉进啤酒里的东西上。

lines.en: : I thought you were done with crying?
lines.zh: : 我记得你不是不哭了吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, me too. Which is why I think we should stop and do something else.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我也这么以为。所以我觉得我们该停下来,干点别的。

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如?

lines.en: : How about you pick? I feel bad sucking you into this game thing when you probably just came here to drink and relax.
lines.zh: : 你来选怎么样?把你硬拉进这个游戏,我挺过意不去的——你多半只是想来喝一杯、放松放松。

lines.en: : I can pick?
lines.zh: : 我可以选?

lines.en: : Sure. Yeah. Pick whatever you want and we can do that.
lines.zh: : 当然。选吧,选什么都行,我们就干什么。

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 就是说……

lines.en: : You mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思?

lines.en: : There are two bathrooms here, you know.
lines.zh: : 这里有两个洗手间,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Do you have to go? I can wait.
lines.zh: : 你要去?我可以等。

lines.en: : Not what I was saying.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是这个。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那你想——

lines.en: : Oh.
: That’s what you meant.
lines.zh: : 原来你说的是那个。

lines.en: : I was just-
lines.zh: : 我只是——

lines.en: : Do you think I’m a slut?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是荡妇吗?

lines.en: : I’m not trying to be confrontational and I won’t blame you if you do. I just want to know.
lines.zh: : 我不是想挑衅,你就算这么想,我也不会怪你。我只是想知道。

lines.en: : I mean...you definitely have a lot of stories. And I have seen you make out with Imani on a dare.
lines.zh: : 呃……你的「故事」确实很多。而且我见过你因为打赌和 Imani 接吻。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 是。没冤枉我。

lines.en: : I won’t pretend like my younger years weren’t a little...all over the place. I was far from innocent and...definitely...experimented a lot.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装我年轻的时候不……混乱。我远谈不上清白,而且……绝对……尝试过很多东西。

lines.en: : But it’s not like that lifestyle followed me when I met Rie. That was me, like...genuinely settling down.
lines.zh: : 但那种生活方式,在我遇见 Rie 之后没有跟着我。那是我真心实意地……安定下来。

lines.en: : And the Imani thing was a combination of break-up pain and not really thinking kissing is a big deal. But, then again, that’s probably just because I’ve...with a lot of...yeah...
lines.zh: : 至于 Imani 那件事,是分手的痛加上「接吻不算什么大事」的叠加。不过话说回来,那大概只是因为我……和很多……嗯……

lines.en: : Besides, she’s the one you want anyway, right? And I’m just the spontaneous, easy backup plan.
lines.zh: : 再说了,你想要的反正也是她,对吧?我只是那个随叫随到、容易上手的备胎。

lines.en: : You think I want Imani?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我想要 Imani?

lines.en: : Yeah, I mean...even if you're not dating, aren't you guys kind of, like...together-ish?
lines.zh: : 对,就是说……就算你们没在约会,你们不也算……勉强算在一起吗?

lines.en: : Like...there’s definitely some kind of “will they, won’t they” thing going on with you two and I just kind of figured there was some...tension.
lines.zh: : 就是……你们俩之间明显有种「会不会在一起」的拉扯,我就自作主张地以为,你们之间有点……暧昧。

lines.en: : Didn’t you also think something similar about Wakana and me during our first meeting?
lines.zh: : 我们第一次见面时,你不也这样以为我和 Wakana 吗?

lines.en: : Lowkey, I still kind of think that. But Wakana is a friend and I know she loves Osako.
lines.zh: : 小声说,我现在还有点这么以为。但 Wakana 是朋友,而且我知道她爱 Osako。

lines.en: : You and Imani, though...I’m surprised you’re, like...not together-ish if that’s what you’re trying to tell me right now.
lines.zh: : 可你和 Imani……我倒是挺意外,你居然……没有勉强算在一起——如果你现在想告诉我的是这个的话。

lines.en: : That is what I’m trying to tell you right now. Weirdly enough, absolutely nothing has happened between the two of us yet.
lines.zh: : 那正是我想告诉你的。说来奇怪,我们俩之间,至今什么都没有发生过。

lines.en: : Okay, but like...why?
lines.zh: : 好吧,但是……为什么?

lines.en: : What do you mean why?
lines.zh: : 你问「为什么」是什么意思?

lines.en: : I mean she obviously likes you. You know that, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说,她明显喜欢你。你知道的吧?

lines.en: : Whenever you’re not around, she’s always checking her phone and asking us if she should invite you or not. It’s super noticeable. And you’ve got crazy good chemistry when you are together.
lines.zh: : 只要你不在场,她就一直在看手机、问我们要不要叫上你。超明显。而且你们俩在一起的时候,化学反应好得吓人。

lines.en: : Like, frankly, it feels kind of weird hanging out with you when she’s not around because I keep thinking of how jealous she’d be and stuff.
lines.zh: : 说实话,她不在场的时候和你出去玩,我都有点别扭——因为我会一直想她该多嫉妒什么的。

lines.en: : Does she really do all of that?
lines.zh: : 她真的会做那些?

lines.en: : Yeah. She’s down bad for you, dude. I don’t get why you don’t just go for it.
lines.zh: : 对。她为你沦陷了,伙计。我不懂你为什么不干脆追。

lines.en: : Are you, like...with someone else already?
lines.zh: : 你是不是……已经有别人了?

lines.en: : If I was, would I have invited you to the bathroom a few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 要是有的话,我几分钟前邀请你去洗手间干嘛?

lines.en: : You think that’s ever stopped anyone from inviting me into other bathrooms?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那种事阻止过别人邀请我去洗手间吗?

lines.en: : Good point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : You know, I probably shouldn’t be telling you this, but I am seeing someone else. Several people actually.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我大概不该告诉你,但我确实在和别人交往。其实是好几个人。

lines.en: : Why shouldn’t you be telling me that? I’m not going to blurt it out to anyone.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不该告诉我?我又不会说出去。

lines.en: : You mean like how you blurted out that thing about Rin taking too long in the shower because of teenage hormones?
lines.zh: : 你是说,就像你把「Rin 洗澡太久是因为青春期荷尔蒙」那件事直接喊出来一样?

lines.en: : This is different. This is serious. Your secret’s safe with me, goober.
lines.zh: : 这次不一样。这次是认真的。你的秘密在我这儿很安全,傻鹅。

lines.en: : Stop calling me that.
lines.zh: : 别再那样叫我了。

lines.en: : No. It’s a term of endearment now. So tell me what’s up.
lines.zh: : 不。这已经是爱称了。那么,说说你的事。

lines.en: : If you’re seeing so many other people, what’s stopping you from getting with Imani when literally everyone ever knows she wants it?
lines.zh: : 你既然在和这么多人交往,是什么拦着你不和 Imani 在一起——全世界都知道她想要?

lines.en: : Come on. I know you know the answer.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我知道你知道答案。

lines.en: : That’s...kind of the thing. I don’t.
lines.zh: : 这……就是问题所在。我不知道。

lines.en: : We joke about our relationship all the time. And I definitely want to have sex with her because she’s extremely attractive.
lines.zh: : 我们总拿我们的关系开玩笑。而且我 definitely 想和她做——因为她性感得要命。

lines.en: : But I also...
lines.zh: : 但我也……

lines.en: : Think I might...actually care about her?
lines.zh: : 觉得我可能……真的在乎她?

lines.en: : You say that like it’s a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像这是件坏事。

lines.en: : It is, though. That sort of thing normally doesn’t happen until after I’ve already started “progressing” things with someone.
lines.zh: : 它就是坏事。这种事,通常发生在我已经和某人「推进」关系之后。

lines.en: : But with Imani, everything feels a little too natural already. Like we’re already-
lines.zh: : 可 Imani 不同,一切都自然得过分。好像我们已经——

lines.en: : Together-ish?
lines.zh: : 勉强算在一起了?

lines.en: : Together-ish.
lines.zh: : 勉强算在一起了。

lines.en: : I just like the way things are right now and don’t want to ruin what we have going.
lines.zh: : 我就是喜欢现在的样子,不想毁掉我们已经拥有的东西。

lines.en: : So you won’t hook up with her because you care about her.
lines.zh: : 所以你不和她上床,是因为你在乎她。

lines.en: : Right.
: But you’ll hook up with me because you don’t care.
lines.zh: : 但你愿意和我上床,因为你不在乎。

lines.en: : That’s not what I-
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思——

lines.en: : I didn’t...mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 我不是……那个意思。

lines.en: : You did.
lines.zh: : 你就是。

lines.en: : And it’s fine that you did. I get it.
lines.zh: : 而且你是了也没关系。我懂。

lines.en: : I’d probably have a hard time taking me seriously too.
lines.zh: : 换作是我,大概也很难把我自己当回事。

lines.en: : I’m sad. Alone. Open. Friendly. Gullible. Dumb. Old. Have a hard time saying no.
lines.zh: : 我悲伤。孤独。敞开。友善。轻信。蠢。老。很难说不。

lines.en: : All signs point to me being an easy target. I’m not gonna blame you for trying to take a shot.
lines.zh: : 所有迹象都表明我是个容易得手的目标。你想试一试,我不会怪你。

lines.en: : I just don’t want to be that kind of person anymore.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想再当那种人了。

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m gonna head home for the night. Sorry for flaking. It’s not your fault, it’s mine.
lines.zh: : 呃……我今晚先回家了。放鸽子抱歉。不是你的问题,是我的。

lines.en: : You can’t leave yet. I need a partner for the rest of the game.
lines.zh: : 你还不能走。比赛剩下的部分我需要搭档。

lines.en: : Those two won’t be back for at least an hour. And I don’t want to wind up giving you even more reasons to not care about me, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 那两位至少一个小时回不来。而我不想再给你更多「不在乎我」的理由,所以……就这样吧。

lines.en: : I’ll see you next time, though. And again, this is a me thing. Not a you thing. You didn’t do anything wrong and-
lines.zh: : 不过下次见。再说一遍,这是我的问题。不是你的。你什么都没做错,而且——

lines.en: : Yeah. I just...fucked up the vibes. That’s my bad, man. See you next- yeah. Already said that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我只是……把气氛搞砸了。怪我,伙计。下次见——对,刚说过了。

lines.en: : Later! Sorry!
lines.zh: : 回头见!抱歉!

lines.en: The MC comes back into the bar a few minutes later and notices that everyone else has left.
lines.zh: : 几分钟后,主持人回到酒吧,发现其他人全都走了。

lines.en: I solemnly answer his trivia questions on my own.
lines.zh: : 我神情庄重地独自回答完他的问答题目。

lines.en: And even though I win, it feels like I lose.
lines.zh: : 而尽管我赢了,感觉却像输了。

lines.en: Rika’s affection has increased by 3!
lines.zh: Rika 的好感度提升了 3!

lines.en: You have unsuccessfully attempted to seduce a woman!
lines.zh: : 你尝试诱惑一名女性,失败!

lines.en: Maybe you should stick to children!
lines.zh: : 也许你更适合招惹未成年人!
